name: Youin no Yakata
source:
Protagonist has an inherited power to subdue wills even of toughest politicians and bureaucrats. He uses this power to confine a number of women in his mansion and apply slavery training.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公继承了一种力量，就连最顽固的政客与官僚也会在他面前屈服。他用这种力量把多名女性囚禁在自己的宅邸里，对她们进行奴隶调教。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vndb-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
